Name: Spine
Description: This will create a IK FK Spine System (v002: no End flip, 3-11 joints, tweakers, matrix based for faster playback)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a IK FK Spine System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- Breath: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- OrientToWorld: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- JointCount: how many joints along the spine (3, 5, 7, 9 or 11, default 5). Joints on a guide keep its name (Root, Base, Belly, Chest, End), in-betweens are MidXX.
- Tweakers: adds one extra controller per joint (tweakCtrls on the spine attrs) to move, rotate and scale each bind joint on its own.
- SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Spine_Inv_Jnt, Spine_F_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
